assumptions: Criteria remain pending the lead gate and independent review, despite all targeted rows passing.

Production authority transport is VELDO-0323, not built on this branch. As the existing wrapper does, the helper reports ledger_unreachable with an enabled installation and no wiring. It opens no private ledger and sends nothing. Rows inject the receiver-style authority wiring; a live central-service gate is not proven.

The fixtures alone supply the two unbuilt act checks (VELDO-0332 and VELDO-0339), an empty process table for the removers' probes, synthetic free-byte readings and a stub Docker client. The holder of a hold is read from the real process table. Production act guards, signatures, packet checks, probes, keeper and removers are unchanged. No actual engine, protected volume or owner data was touched.

Admission retries and historical needs are later tickets; this helper uses the current arithmetic. The unconfirmed no-space retry policy is not built: an error without a below-floor pool keeps the ordinary verdict.

The gate ends its process group only when it leads one (started by the host holder, or by a shell with job control). A gate that is a member of its caller's group ends nobody; the other children of its parent are never ended. Candidate mode with a sink was not run with space management on: a sink outside every known root is refused by the ledger and such a gate answers NOT STARTED.
The holder is read from /proc. On a host without it, a gate with space management on answers NOT STARTED.

The standard full gate and the policy checker were not run in this round. Suite 153, the teeth check for finding 309 and the other suites that start a gate script were run under nice 10 on a host loaded by another gate.
rollback: Revert the gate steps, helper, scaffold entry and the two protected helper entries. Gate behavior returns to the previous form.
